observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 220.» (L7, beside the head of C) and «p. 221.» (L28) in the left margin; in both locators the 2s are printed blotted. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of C: 10 stands beside the first line of the title.
body L7-L9: the head C is set in a larger bold type, the title in a larger type, both centred.
body L2: a short stroke rises from the last e of «quaere,» like an acute; it is not an accent.
body L28: a blot joins the tops of the a and the first n of «repertis annum».
notes_right L1: «cfr. cap. XXXII, p. 67, adn. 1.» is printed with thin spaces.
body L38: the dash of «sem al-muḥarram» measures 4.4 pt, between the hyphen of L22 (3.4 pt) and the longer dash of the other lines (5.3 to 5.5 pt); it is transcribed as a hyphen.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
